content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 4 up, 1 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 6 of 6 planned. Sets: 92 (last week 92).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- Barbell Bench Press: 80 kg x 8 (last week 77.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.2%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Back Squat: 100 kg x 6 (last week 97.5 kg x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 8 sets this week
- Assisted Pull-up: 8 reps with 30 kg assist (last week 8 reps with 30 kg assist), flat (3 weeks without a new best), 8 sets this week
- Romanian Deadlift: 90 kg x 8 (last week 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 8 sets this week
- Barbell Row: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): Barbell Bench Press 80 kg x 8; Barbell Back Squat 100 kg x 6; Romanian Deadlift 90 kg x 8; Barbell Row 70 kg x 8.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for Chest, Back, Side delts, Rear delts, Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Biceps, Triceps; the others have no range): Chest 18 (last week 18), Back 31 (above the range; last week 31), Front delts 15 (last week 15), Side delts 10 (last week 10), Rear delts 10 (last week 10), Quads 14 (last week 14), Hamstrings 12 (last week 12), Glutes 22 (above the range; last week 22), Biceps 17 (last week 17), Triceps 15 (last week 15), Calves 2 (last week 2).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "Get my first pull-up".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- lift_stalled (priority 60). Advice: Double progression: keep the weight and add reps on every set until all sets reach the top of the rep range, then add the smallest jump (2.5 kg upper body, 5 kg lower body). For an assisted lift, keep the assist and add reps, then lower the assist by the smallest step.
    - Assisted Pull-up: data {"name":"Assisted Pull-up","nameZh":"輔助引體向上","best":"8 reps with 30 kg assist","previousBest":"8 reps with 30 kg assist","change":null,"bodyweight":0,"assisted":1,"flatWindows":3}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 25 words.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next week about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's notes: if one mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in English.
